prompt: Make a short film that opens on one statement as its whole first shot: 'Most dashboards hide where a number came from', with the word 'hide' emphasised. Add a second shot that answers it with a statement of your own. Keep it under 12 seconds.
Make a KPI film with one number shot: the figure counts up to 18 with a % suffix, labelled 'weekly active teams', with the change badge '+4 pts'. Narrate it in one sentence.
Show data/portrait.jpg as a clipping with the caption 'The speaker'. Name a region around the face and push in on it when the narration says 'face'. Narrate two short sentences.
Make a film with one list shot of three numbered steps: Ingest, Transform, Publish. Each step is one sentence of the narration and arrives with it.
Make a film with a quote card: 'Make it work, make it right, make it fast', said by Kent Beck. Narrate the quote itself.
Make a before-and-after comparison of p95 latency: before 420 ms, after 95 ms, with a headline sentence 'Latency down 77%'. Use one compare shot in before-after mode.
Make a film that reveals a bar or column chart of quarterly signups (Q1 1200, Q2 1850, Q3 2400, Q4 3100), highlights Q4, and says 'Signups grew every quarter'.
Make a vertical film for Reels in the viral mode with three shots: a hook statement, a number shot counting up to 64%, and an end card whose ask is 'Read the report'.

Make a 15-second narrated explainer in the pro mode with three shots, each with its own spoken line (say), about why a team should keep its data in one file. Do not set a duration on a shot that has a spoken line.
Edit the existing film.json: change the number shot so it counts to 25 and its spoken line says twenty five. Keep everything else unchanged.

Make a welcome film with the variables name, city (strings) and count (a number): 'Welcome {{name}} from {{city}}', then a number shot that counts up to {{count}}. Give each variable a default. Then say which command renders one film for each row of data/rows.json.
